turns.question: By what percentage did our ad spend grow in the week of 14 September 2026 over the week before?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ad spend week-over-week growth metric, so I can't give a percentage for this question. The closest metrics are Ad spend (EUR) (ad_spend_eur, which can be grouped by week), and the week-over-week growth metrics Leads week-over-week growth (leads_wow_growth) and Bookings week-over-week growth (bookings_wow_growth), which are not ad spend.
